name: What types of materials are available for deck board replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are available for deck board replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for deck board replacement include pressure-treated lumber, cedar, redwood, and composite decking. Pressure-treated lumber is a cost-effective option known for its resistance to rot and insects. Cedar and redwood offer natural beauty and decay resistance, though they require more maintenance. Composite decking, made from wood fibers and plastic, is highly durable and low-maintenance, but generally has a higher upfront cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Materials include pressure-treated lumber, cedar, redwood, and composite decking, each with different durability, maintenance, and cost profiles.
